source.provider: NASA LP DAAC / ORNL DAAC TESViS

collectionVerification.method: Exact MODIS acquisition-date + native tile + processing-ID match against NASA CMR granule IDs; not a version inferred from the current product catalog.

site.name: Sitio piloto del Chaco seco
site.scopeWarning: Un píxel nativo que contiene el punto consultado. No es un promedio del Gran Chaco, ni de una ventana de 1° × 1°.
site.locationSelection: Coordenadas fijadas antes de recolectar o evaluar la serie; no elegidas por el resultado.

qualityPolicy.name: strict-v1
qualityPolicy.warning: Good QA is a screening criterion, not a proof of absence of measurement error. Downstream variable-specific policies may recalculate usability from the original flags.

dateSemantics: date starts a native 16-day compositing window; final annual window is truncated at January 1. selectedDayOfYear is the actual day chosen by the native pixel compositor. periodDays are represented days, not independent daily observations.
